G3578069.description: Plymouth is a ghost town and the de jure capital of the island of Montserrat, an overseas territory of the United Kingdom located in the Leeward Island chain of the Lesser Antilles, West Indies. It is the only ghost town that is the capital of a political territory.

G7266440.description: Brades (; also Brades Estate) is a town and the seat of government of Montserrat since 1998 with an approximate population of 1,000.
